title: WenArt building model
description: One merged building model per project. Every element carries evidence. Units: metres, degrees. Coordinates: building-local XY, Z up; each level has its own elevation. Milestone 10 (docs/milestone10.md §1.1): building z = 0 at the finished floor of the level with order 0 (the ±0.00 mark); fields named 'building z' are absolute in that frame (slab z_top, roof heights and planes, site z, ground levels, facade z_range), the others are above their level's floor (opening sill and height, decor center[2], mount_bottom_m). The building XY frame is the reference plan's frame (docs/milestone10.md §3.1 item 5). Angles: front_deg, rotation_deg and aspect_deg are degrees counter-clockwise from +X (front = local -Y at rotation 0, so front_deg = (270 + rotation_deg) mod 360); compass bearings (azimuth_deg, north_deg) are clockwise from north.

unit_system.description: The unit system of the master pages (docs/milestone7.md §1.1); reports show imperial projects in feet-inches with metres

datum.description: Milestone 10: the printed absolute level at building z 0 (e.g. 43.00 from a section mark); null when no mark is drawn

status.description: needs_review = something critical is missing (scale, closed outer walls). The pipeline stops after the report.

decor.description: Decor inside the building (wenart/furniture/decor.py rules, wenart/furniture/decor_ai.py AI decor): always added_by_ai, never furniture; absent before the decor stage

unverified.description: IDs of elements with status=unverified (copied here for the report)

variants.description: Milestone 10 (docs/milestone10.md §1.1): one entry per buildable combination: base plus one per alternative plan (only that level differs), written by the pipeline (brief variants: all | base | names). Absent or empty = one base variant of every level without a variant

levels_left_out.description: Milestone 10 (failed_levels: leave_out): plan levels that were not built (no scale, open outer walls) and the levels above them; a failed alternative removes only its variant. The building status stays ok while at least one level remains

slabs.description: Milestone 10: the slabs under every level (between levels, and under the lowest level); absent = the M3-M9 floors and ceilings only

roof.description: Milestone 10: the roof over the top level

facade.description: Milestone 10: the outside faces of the outer walls

agent_overrides.description: Milestone 11 (docs/milestone11.md §17): the accepted agent edits the build reads

site.description: Plot elements outside the building (docs/milestone7.md §1.3, §2.5); Milestone 10 (docs/milestone10.md §3.2): buildable, every element with build true/false and its source

kind.description: plot = a wall component whose convex hull holds the building (compound wall); other = any other wall without room labels

height.description: Milestone 10: wall height (elevation drawing, else assumed)

label.description: Exterior label as printed: Parking, Garden, ...

polygon.description: null unless a closed face exists

extent_m.description: Open extent around the label (x, y) to the nearest wall or the plot hull, metres

kind.description: Milestone 10: what the label names (wenart/ingest/generic/labels.py exterior keywords)

build.description: Milestone 10: always false: areas are label records (evidence); the built surfaces are site.plot, paving, grass, parking, boundary_walls and site.decor

items.description: Doors, windows and gaps in site boundary walls

ground.description: Milestone 10: the DRAWN terrain levels around the building (section ground lines, elevations, the site plan); one assumed level {side all, z 0.0} only when nothing is drawn. The build adds its own assumed terrain changes (basement doors, light wells) to the scene manifest, never here

azimuth_deg.description: Compass bearing of the side's outward normal (building bearing + north_deg); null when north is unknown

terrain.description: flat = one ground level; sides = per side (a sloped site)

light_wells.description: Drawn light wells only (assumed ones live in the scene manifest)

north_deg.description: Milestone 10: compass bearing of the building's +Y axis (site plan north arrow, after the site plan's registration); null = unknown (the build assumes 0 and lists it)

plot.description: Milestone 10: the plot boundary polygon (site plan or the plot walls' hull)

evidence.description: Where this fact comes from. At least one evidence entry per element.

file.description: Path relative to the project folder

page.description: 1-based page for PDFs; null for DXF/images

layer.description: DXF layer name, e.g. DUVAR, KAPI, MOBILYA

entity.description: DXF entity handle or PDF path index, e.g. INSERT:1F3A

pixel_box.description: [x0,y0,x1,y1] in page pixels at the recorded dpi

method.description: Trust order: vector > raster/ocr > ai. inferred = Milestone 11: inferred where the documents are silent, unclear or illogical (listed in the report). raster = deterministic image processing of a scan or photo (docs/milestone7.md). derived = computed from other verified elements (e.g. room polygon from walls).

pass.description: AI pass number (1 or 2) for two-pass agreement

text.description: Raw text read, e.g. 'Salon 24,50 m²' or '3,45'

region_id.description: Milestone 10: the sheets.json drawing region the fact was read from

rule.description: Milestone 10: the deterministic rule that decided (title_keyword, slab_bands, face_pairs, unit_check, ...)

side.description: Milestone 10: a side of the building: compass when north is known, else drawing-relative (front = -Y, back = +Y, left = -X, right = +X); a wall's side is its outward normal within ±45°

value.description: Milestone 10: a measured or assumed number with its evidence (heights, pitches, terrain levels). method assumed = no drawing gives it (listed in the report; confidence 0 and a note); method ai never builds geometry (treated as assumed); vector, raster, ocr and derived carry at least one evidence entry

z.description: Surface height (building z); null = the ground level of its side

material.description: Exterior vocabulary slug (docs/milestone10.md §1.4; a slug never carries a colour); null = the build resolves it from the style (assumed, scene manifest)

area_id.description: The site.areas label record this surface was built from, if any

converter.description: e.g. libredwg dwg2dxf 0.14 d9468ae; audit: 0 errors, 0 fixes

conversion.description: DWG only: LibreDWG version, $ACADVER of the source, model-space entity counts, audit (docs/milestone7.md §5.1)

unit_system.description: Majority of the document's parsed lengths (docs/milestone7.md §1.1)

source_kind.description: How the document was read (generic page model, docs/milestone7.md §1.2)

region_id.description: Milestone 10: the sheets.json region this page record reads (one record per region; null = the whole page, M2-M9)

region_box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the region in source units: DXF model space drawing units (y up); PDF points in the cad_pdf GenericPage frame (origin bottom-left, y up); raster: original image pixels (y down). Debug images and plan crops of a region page render only this box (+ margin)

region_class.description: The sheets.json class of the region (floor_plan, alternative_floor_plan, section, ...); pages[].class is floor_plan for an alternative_floor_plan region. One page record per region with use read, heights or exterior; ignored regions only in sheets.json

variant.description: base or the alternative's name (plan regions of a variant group)

classifier.description: Which rule classified the page: title | generic_labels (room-name labels + a wall structure, docs/milestone7.md §2.1) | ocr

rectified_image.description: Raster pages: the rectified image under the output folder

to_original.description: Raster pages: 3x3 matrix, page units -> original image pixels

method.description: unit_check (Milestone 10): the sheets stage's unit check decided the unit (sheets.json documents[].units); the evidence names the agreeing checks and a unit_mismatch conflict names the header value

transform_to_building.description: Affine [a,b,c,d,e,f] mapping page/model coords to building coords

aspect.description: Photos: the sheet aspect (width / height of the page quad): measured, method, side_ratio, snapped, name, off_pct, assumed, solved_from, factor, checked_by_dimensions (docs/milestone7.md §4.1)

label.description: Normalised: Bodrum Kat, Zemin Kat, 1. Kat, Çatı Katı ...

ceiling_height.description: Floor to ceiling. Milestone 10, kind attic: the height above the floor of the flat ceiling part (the roof underside is cut flat there); with no flat part drawn, the roof underside at the ridge. Attic walls are never clipped by it: they end at the roof underside

label_source.description: assumed = no level title on the only plan page: L0 Ground floor (docs/milestone7.md §2.1); evidence = the room labels. section_order (Milestone 10) = an untitled plan placed in the one free level slot (listed as assumed)

kind.description: Milestone 10: attic = the top level under a pitched roof (sloped ceilings from the roof)

variant_group.description: Milestone 10: vg_<base level id> when the level has alternative plans

variant.description: Milestone 10: base, or the alternative's name as titled (Açık mutfak); alternative levels get the id <base id>b, <base id>c ...

variant_slug.description: ASCII slug of variant, hyphens (wenart.building.variant_slug: acik-mutfak); base levels: base

base_level_id.description: Alternative levels: the base level they replace

region_id.description: Milestone 10: the sheets.json region the level was read from

elevation_source.description: Milestone 10: where the elevation comes from

id.description:
base, or - (wenart.building.variant_id: l-1b-acik-mutfak): filesystem-safe, used in outputs/

/variants// and

-.blend/.glb

label.description: Readable name: Base, Bodrum Kat: Açık mutfak (open kitchen)

levels.description: The level ids this variant builds, bottom up

rooms_changed.description: Written by the pipeline: the rooms of the alternative level with same_as null (rendered for this variant); empty for base; null = not computed (wenart.views.variant_changes derives it)

exterior_changed.description: Written by the pipeline: true when an exterior wall (start/end within 2 cm, thickness) or an opening on one (type, centre, width, height, sill within 2 cm) of the alternative level has no base match (its exterior views are rendered); false for base; null = not computed

id.description: sl_<level id of the level above>; a slab whose outline or void differs for an alternative is written again as sl_<above>__<variant id> with variants [<variant id>]. Level and furniture ids name base ids; a variant reads them through variants[].changes (replaces -> level_id) and the alternative's stair at the same position (within 0.1 m)

above_level_id.description: The level whose floor this slab carries

z_top.description: Top of the slab = floor of the level above (building z)

outline.description: Outer face of the outer walls of the level above (the level below when larger)

variants.description: Variant ids this slab belongs to (empty = all)

type_source.description: plan_roof_lines = the roof outline and break lines drawn on the top plan

over_level_id.description: The level the roof covers (the attic or the top floor)

eaves_height.description: Building z of the roof's top surface at the eaves edge (absolute, not above the attic floor)

ridge_height.description: Building z of the roof's top surface at the ridge

pitches_deg.description: One per slope from the eaves up (mansard: steep then shallow)

overhang.description: Horizontal distance from the outer wall face to the eaves; used only when no outline is drawn (the outline wins)

thickness.description: Measured perpendicular to the slope (underside z = top z - thickness / cos(slope))

knee_wall.description: Attic: the roof's top surface at the outer face of the outer wall minus the attic floor; a cross-check only: wall tops and attic ceilings are cut from the planes' underside

profile.description: The section's roof line copied from sheets.json heights.roof.profile

points.description: [s, z]: s = building metres along cut_axis, z = building z of the top surface

outline.description: Eaves outline in plan (drawn on the top plan or the roof plan; else the walls + overhang, assumed)

break_line.description: Mansard / gambrel: the closed line where the slope changes

planes.description: May be empty from the pipeline: the build derives them (wenart.blender.roof.planes_for)

points.description: Top (outer) roof surface polygon, building x, y, z

aspect_deg.description: Downhill direction, degrees counter-clockwise from +X (downhill -Y = 270); not a compass bearing; null for flat

polygon.description: The plan area removed from the roof surface: the room polygon extended over the outer walls to the roof outline where the room touches an outer wall, else to the centre line of the bounding wall

covering.description: Drawn covering only (elevation / roof plan label or hatch): exterior vocabulary slug without colour (clay_tiles, concrete_tiles, slate, standing_seam, green_roof); null = the build resolves it from brief > style > style.exterior_fallback (assumed, scene manifest)

assumed.description: What no drawing gives (e.g. 'hip/gable choice across the section', 'overhang')

facade.description: Milestone 10: what the DRAWINGS say about the outside (written by the pipeline from sheets.json exterior evidence). Brief, style and assumed looks are resolved by the build (wenart.blender.exterior.resolve_looks: documents > brief exterior words > style.json exterior > style.exterior_fallback), recorded in the scene manifest, never written back here

wall_id.description: Optional: one wall only; null = every outward wall face of that side

z_range.description: Building z band of the face (e.g. a stone plinth); null = the whole height

source.description: elevation = hatched or labelled on a drawn elevation

elevations.description: One entry per drawn elevation region

view_bearing_deg.description: Direction the viewer of the elevation looks, degrees counter-clockwise from +X (the camera of §3.3 looks the same way)

positions_m.description: Per opening: kind, x from the facade's left end seen from outside, sill, head (building z)

plan_check.description: Filled by the pipeline after reading the plans: matched, missing, extra; null in sheets.json

wall_id.description: null only for a virtual separator (virtual: true, docs/milestone7.md §2.7.1)

virtual.description: true = a separator line between two rooms where no wall exists (type opening, wall_id null)

line.description: Separator line [[x,y],[x,y]] of a virtual separator

assumed.description: Values that are defaults, not drawn (door and doorless height 2.10 m, window sill 0.90 m and height 1.20 m)

type_raw.description: e.g. 'unclassified gap content' for a gap whose strokes are no door, window or empty gap

swing_side.description: Room id the door opens into, if drawn

operation.description: Milestone 10: how the drawn door or window opens (the drawn type always wins over the style's door look); null = swing, assumed

label.description: Normalised Turkish label, e.g. Salon, Yatak Odası, Mutfak, Banyo, Balkon

area_label.description: Area read from the drawing in m², e.g. 24.5 from 'Salon 24,50 m²' (sq ft converted)

room_subtype.description: Milestone 10: child = a child's room (Çocuk Odası, kid, nursery): cribs and bunk beds allowed

adjusted_by_ai.description: Milestone 11: a change by the agent (CLAUDE.md evidence and inference rules): reason, round, log_seq, model, the changed fields with their old values

inferred.description: Milestone 11: inferred by code or the agent, not read from the documents; listed in the report

corrected_by_ai.description: Milestone 11: a clear geometry error fixed by the agent (correct_geometry): reason, evidence, before

twin_of.description: Milestone 10: the room this one mirrors in a semi-detached pair (same label, mirrored polygon, openings and drawn furniture within 2 cm); set on the second twin only (the one later in reading order)

twin_transform.description: Affine [a, b, c, d, e, f] mapping the first twin onto this room (a mirror), fitted by the pipeline from polygons, openings and drawn furniture

same_as.description: Milestone 10: on an alternative level, the base room this room equals (polygon within 2 cm, same openings, same drawn furniture)

decor.description: One decor item (docs/milestone4.md §4, docs/milestone8.md §4, docs/milestone9.md §3-§4): added_by_ai by rule or by the AI decorator, labelled decor (not furniture). Cushions, book sets, vases, bowls, small plants and table lamps sit on their host piece (host_id); plants, rugs, wall art and mirrors have no host (host_id null) and are their own decor element in the scene; rugs, wall art and mirrors name the pieces they belong to in anchor_ids. AI decor (method ai) carries its slot, colour and the evidence of both agreeing passes.

pot.description: Milestone 10: plant pot material and colour (from the brief)

window_id.description: Milestone 10: curtain / blind: the window it covers (never a door)

light_on.description: Milestone 10: lamps and lights emit in the interior evening mood

mirrored_from.description: Milestone 10: copied (mirrored) from this item of the twin room, or copied from the same_as base room

center.description: [x, y] in building coordinates (an optional third value is the rest height above the floor). Wall art: half its nominal depth in front of wall_point

rotation_deg.description: Rotation about +Z; the item's front is its local -Y (wall art faces the room)

size.description: [width, depth] (+ height) in metres in the item's frame; at most 0.6 m except rugs and wall art

asset.description: Library decor model chosen by the fit (wenart/furniture/fit.py fit_decor_item), or null: parametric decor (wall art: not built)

host_id.description: The furniture piece a cushion or book set sits on; null for plants, rugs and wall art

anchor_ids.description: Rug: the pieces of its group (sofa + coffee table, the double bed, the dining table). Wall art: the piece it hangs over

method.description: rule: the decor rules (docs/milestone4.md §4, docs/milestone8.md §4); ai: the AI decorator, both passes agreeing (docs/milestone9.md §4)

slot.description: AI decor: the slot the item fills (docs/milestone9.md §4)

colour.description: AI decor: the accent colour (a style vocabulary colour name) both passes chose, else pass 1's

evidence.description: AI decor: one entry per agreeing pass (method ai, model, pass, confidence, the reason)

wall_point.description: Wall art: the centre of its back on the wall face

wall_id.description: Wall art: the building wall it hangs on (nearest wall to wall_point), null when none is near

gap_m.description: Wall art: bottom edge above the top of the piece it hangs over

bottom_m.description: Wall art: bottom edge above the floor from the piece's box at decor time (the scene builder re-hangs it over the built top)

max_height_m.description: Wall art: the most height it may take up to 0.1 m under the ceiling

type_raw.description: Block name or label as drawn, e.g. KANEPE_3LU, yatak

type_method.description: How the type was decided (generic core, docs/milestone7.md §2.8, §3.3)

type_candidates.description: The AI passes' answers: {type, model, pass, confidence, front, reason}

build.description: false = a drawn symbol both AI passes call not_furniture: kept as an obstacle, not built (default true)

assumed.description: Values that are assumed, not decided: front_deg = the drawn front kept although both AI passes answered 'none' (review ingest-6)

stair.description: Stair rule result: flights [{start, end, width, lines, spacing}], landing, direction, *_assumed, riser_m, riser_source

spacing.description: Distance between the drawn tread lines, metres

reason.description: Why direction and turn are assumed

shape.description: round = a circle fits >= 90 % of the drawn outline (docs/milestone7.md §6.4: a round side table); L = the corner sofa (Milestone 10: chaise_side, chaise_depth); absent = the footprint rectangle

chaise_side.description: L shape: the side of the chaise; right = local +X = the right of a viewer facing the sofa's front. In the piece frame (front = local -Y, back edge at y = +D/2): main seat x in [-W/2, W/2], y in [D/2 - seat_depth, D/2]; chaise x in [W/2 - chaise_width, W/2] (right) or [-W/2, -W/2 + chaise_width] (left), y in [-D/2, D/2]. A mirrored twin flips it. wenart.furniture.schemas.l_parts gives both rectangles

chaise_depth.description: L shape: = the footprint depth D (kept for readers of the first M10 contract)

seat_depth.description: L shape: depth of the main seat along the back (default 0.9)

chaise_width.description: L shape: width of the chaise (default 0.9)

mount_bottom_m.description: Milestone 10: bottom of a wall-hung piece above the level floor (wall_cabinet 1.45, by rule); null or absent = stands on the floor. Wall-hung pieces are not floor obstacles: exempt from no_overlap with floor pieces, the door approach strip and the walkways

circle_fit.description: The circle fitted to the drawn outline: share of the outline on it, radius in metres

counter_run.description: Kitchen counter rule: the wall the run stands against and its strokes

adjusted_by_ai.description: Milestone 11: a change by the agent (CLAUDE.md evidence and inference rules): reason, round, log_seq, model, the changed fields with their old values

inferred.description: Milestone 11: inferred by code or the agent, not read from the documents; listed in the report

drawn_front_deg.description: Milestone 11: the drawn front before an agent change

modified_by_ai.description: Milestone 10 (furnished_rooms: complete): a drawn piece whose type, size, height or look the AI changed; location (anchor) and position (front, wall) stay as drawn

drawn_type.description: modified_by_ai: the type as the documents gave it

drawn_height.description: modified_by_ai: the height before the change

anchor.description: Milestone 10: the locked location of a drawn piece: its footprint centre (free piece) or the midpoint of its back edge on the wall line (against a wall within 5 cm)

type_proposal.description: Milestone 10: an unverified drawn piece whose type is the AI's agreed proposal (status stays unverified)

completes_room.description: Milestone 10: added_by_ai in a room with drawn furniture (furnished_rooms: complete)

method.description: Milestone 10: how an added piece was placed (rule: wall cabinets along a counter run)

mirrored_from.description: Milestone 10: the AI decision copied (mirrored) from this piece of the twin room, or copied from the same_as base room

design.description: Milestone 10 looks (docs/milestone10.md §4.4-§4.7), written by the layout stage (track B) for every piece of a completed or kept room from style.json and the agreed answers; the fit and the build only read it

wood.description: Furniture wood: a FURNITURE_MATERIALS wood_veneer_* slug

material_tags.description: What the brief asks for (the fit prefers library models with these judged tags)

rule.description: Milestone 10: how a rule-placed piece (method rule) was placed, e.g. a wall cabinet's counter run and band

checks.description: Placer checks of an AI-placed piece (inside_room, no_overlap, clearance_ok, doors_free, windows_free, wall_contact)

front_deg.description: Direction the piece faces (e.g. away from a bed headboard, out of a sofa back), degrees counter-clockwise from +X; = (270 + footprint.rotation_deg) mod 360 when known. null = not determinable

asset.description: Chosen 3D asset: library, id, license, fit scale

size.description: [width, depth] in metres, in the piece's own frame

label_size.description: A printed room size vs the face's clear size (docs/milestone7.md §2.7.3): ok within max(5 %, 0.15 m) per side, conflict beyond, unchecked for a face that is not rectangular (then w x l vs the face area at 8 %)

unverified.description: true = the size differs enough to mark the room unverified (over 10 % per side, or the area rule)

area_m2.description: Faces that are not rectangular: w x l of the label vs the face area

resolution.description: Which source won (DWG > vector PDF > scan > photo) or 'unresolved'
